method: Actual source audit and personal inspection of all eight fixed exact-GLB final views; no exhaustive triangle-intersection solver claim.
observation: All eight exact final views inspected. Elevated hero/reversehero/top and clay show the summit bowl and inward crater wall; front/side/rear show the compact angle-of-repose-like flanks and low rim. Small radial erosional grooves and a restrained oxidized rim sector are present. The sector boundary is deliberately stylized and simplified, not a mapped deposit. The shallow dry crater is not an active lava pool; no ash cloud, glowing vent or eruption timing is asserted. One continuous closed cone/apron mesh, no nested coincident shells.
limitations: Closed meshes do not certify watertight Boolean unions, printability, all intersections, or independent acceptance.
